<b>Sprintmaster Swift</b> is an [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPC]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. He is a bug seeking to test his speed against a challenger.<ref name=race/> He gives the <i>[[Fastest in Pharloom]]</i> [[wish]].

== Background ==
Sprintmaster Swift is a bug seeking the fastest bug in [[Pharloom]]. In the past, he had his own speed teacher who gave him a [[Sprintmaster Memento|memento]].<ref>Sprintmaster Swift: <i>"As reward for such an impressive feat of endurance, I have only this small trophy, a memento given by my own speed teacher, now fairly passed to you."</i></ref> He is looking for a nimble opponent to challenge him, testing their speed and breaking through their limits.<ref name=race>Sprintmaster Swift: <i>"A nimble opponent appears. At last! At last! (...) Let us break through our limits and see what waits beyond!"</i></ref> In [[Far Fields]], he discovered a distant cavern with a giant, boney body of a bug inside it. Sprintmaster Swift set up his race there to await a challenger.<ref>Hornet and Sprintmaster Swift dialogue: <br><i>Hornet: "If you are seeking challengers, sir, you should choose a location less far afield. It is rare chance I, or any bug, would come upon this distant cavern."<br>Sprintmaster Swift: "True! Though once discovered, could there be a more perfect spot? This giant, boney body, so distant from Pharloom's ails. Here, freely, we can test our speed and our sleek shells. Here we may race!"</i></ref>
== In-Game Events ==
: <i>For more information, see [[Fastest in Pharloom]].</i>

Upon meeting him, Sprintmaster Swift offers the Wish <i>[[Fastest in Pharloom]]</i> to [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]], if she has yet to accept it from the Wishwall in [[Bellhart]]. This consists of a race on three tracks, each increasing in difficulty and offering different rewards for winning them. 

After Hornet completes the first three challenges, upon obtaining the [[Everbloom]] and returning from benching elsewhere, Sprintmaster Swift offers the fourth and final challenge. This takes place on the same track as the third challenge, but is longer, made up of six laps instead of three as before. Beating him on this fourth race rewards Hornet with the [[Sprintmaster Memento]].

Sprintmaster Swift is found at the eastern frontier of [[Far Fields]], reached through [[Hunter's March]] after unlocking the [[Silk Soar]] ability.

== Trivia ==
* It is possible to hit Sprintmaster Swift during the race to slow him down briefly.
* Holding down the [[Controls (Silksong)|SPRINT]] button at the second bell before the race starts gives Hornet a head start.
* Due to a bug, Sprintmaster Swift's races used to be able to be beaten by not moving until he finishes the race, then completing it. This has since been fixed.
